policy.prefix: Rebuild all 17 fixed features on every request from immutable exact base/text imports.
policy.suffix: 14 features: three sketch/extrude pairs, six body placements, union, and text placement

limitations: Empirical nearest-rank quantiles; 4 processes and 16 retained ticks per variant/mode do not establish tail confidence.
Module load, construction and checkpoint setup are separate; first replay is not cold application launch.
RSS/linear-memory observations are stage snapshots, not lifetime process peaks; no long-session reclamation claim.
Node kernel replay excludes application expression processing, worker/renderer and browser presentation.
Team CPU reservation/quiet-window approval is separate; unrelated host activity is not proven absent.
